feedback.message: Keep FRANK semantics unchanged. Require compiled reusable definition/call identity in BASE rather than FRANK-specific function syntax or host-hidden behavior.

Moving stack should eventually reference the admitted general-purpose CoreIR/frontend contract once production-validated; prior universal-core experiment alone is not current executable stack membership.
Extend source-chain oracle with function-definition/signature identity and call-binding evidence at canonical typed IR/lowering stages; source spelling itself must not mint ProgramSemanticId.
Function resolution is exact symbol/signature identity. Graph activation/relevance must never resolve ambiguous or missing call targets.
Compiler symbol/function identity remains distinct from resource/capability/work records. Execution receipts may reference compiled artifacts without turning DB proximity into call binding.
Definition/call closure is compiler semantics, not workspace selection. GWT stage identities remain orthogonal.
Multiple candidate implementations may coexist in research/search topology, but each compiled call requires one explicit semantic/signature binding in the selected artifact.
Universal computation/function closure does not count as emergence evidence; keep E-CERT2 orthogonal.

Route to BASE frontend/canonical IR/typechecker/compiler: expose prior function/call contract with exact signature binding. No core semantic promotion; branching/recursion/errors/concurrency remain open closure gates.
